description: Configure Raycast's keyboard shortcuts as follows, using Raycast's hotkey recorder in Settings → Extensions / Settings → General as appropriate: (1) Raycast Notes → single-tap of the fn key (use Raycast's single-tap modifier feature, not a chord). (2) Clipboard History → double-tap of the RIGHT Option key (use Raycast's double-tap modifier feature; the recording must register the RIGHT Option specifically, NOT generic Option/Left Option). (3) Quick AI → Left Control + Space (use Raycast's physical left/right modifier semantics; must be Left Control, not generic Control). There is currently another Raycast command (likely the default 'Search Emoji & Symbols' or whatever Raycast has assigned by default) using Left Control + Space — when you set Quick AI to that combination, Raycast will show a conflict dialog. Resolve the Raycast-side conflict by removing the binding from the OTHER Raycast command (set its hotkey to none / unassigned), then assigning Left Control + Space to Quick AI. ALSO: there is a non-Raycast macOS system keyboard shortcut already registered at code 64 ('Move focus to next window') with binding Cmd+`. DO NOT modify that macOS system shortcut — your changes must stay inside Raycast Preferences. After applying all bindings, export Raycast settings to ~/Desktop/raycast_hotkey_export.rayconfig (use Raycast's 'Export Preferences & Data' command; you can leave the export password blank).
